items.title: MongoDB Architecture and Internals: Performance Tuning, Server Configuration and Monitoring
items.summary: A practitioner's guide to MongoDB architecture and internals, drawn from production work on large MongoDB estates. It follows a single request through the driver, mongos, the query layer, the WiredTiger storage engine and disk, and shows where each layer waits and which metric proves it.What the deck covers: WiredTiger cache, eviction thresholds, journal and checkpoints; the document model and embed vs reference decisions; replica set design, write concern and read concern; sharded cluster architecture and a scoring method for shard keys; MongoDB 7.0, 8.0, 8.2, 8.3 and 9.0 support windows; ESR compound indexes, explain executionStats, aggregation pipeline optimization, schema design patterns and anti-patterns; the Cost-Based Ranker and setQuerySettings; transactions and write conflicts; the Linux host baseline (XFS, transparent hugepages, NUMA, swappiness), mongod.conf, WiredTiger cache sizing, connection pools, the profiler, $queryStats and oplog sizing; and the serverStatus, rs.status and sharding metrics worth alerting on, with thresholds.Test every change on your own workload before it reaches production, and keep a restore you have timed.Presented by Shiv Iyer, Founder and CEO of MinervaDB Inc. MinervaDB provides MongoDB consulting, performance engineering, 24x7 consultative support, remote DBA and managed services for self-managed MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas, alongside PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Redis, Valkey and every major cloud DBaaS.
